prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise-object-edit. Make one polished LANDSCAPE mecha mechanical design sheet showing TWO aligned states of THE SAME Social Brave King forearm with the same train shells. This supplements the selected references, not a new robot design.
Reference 1 is the train shell opening/attachment authority. Reference 2 is the exact two-car undersea train identity: ivory shell, orange stripe, blue-black side windows, rounded cab, small folding side fin. Reference 3 locks the huge reinforced fist and resting train-shell silhouette on the approved robot. Reference 4 supports the installed forearm's outside view.
Composition: TWO LARGE HORIZONTAL ROWS on warm ivory background, equal scale, same perspective. In BOTH rows the elbow/rounded train-cab end is at LEFT, the huge knuckled fist points RIGHT. Include a short visible original upper-arm/elbow connection. The train cab nose points back toward the elbow/left, NEVER toward the fist. The original middle coupling end faces the fist/right. Show a single forearm only, never both arms or a separate robot.
TOP ROW: installed REST state, two longitudinal shell halves folded close as a protective U-shaped armor cradle around the SAME orange/graphite reinforced forearm. The visible outside shell looks like the approved whole-body train armor, its blue windows and orange stripe unmistakable. Leave the enormous ivory-plated knuckles, thumb and wrist completely exposed at RIGHT; train armor ends behind the knuckles. The forearm is not a sealed whole train car with a fist glued on.
BOTTOM ROW: the SAME state changed to cannon-ready OPEN, the two long white/blue-window shell halves swing LEFT/RIGHT apart around longitudinal hinge rails as in reference 1. Clearly expose the SAME reinforced forearm frame, orange mechanical spine and wrist. The two opened former-coupling half-rims outline a split cannon aperture around the forward arm, remaining BEHIND the giant fist. No new solid tube blocking or replacing the fist, no missiles or new weapons. The rear cab is split into the same two halves, still toward the elbow/LEFT, not duplicated into two complete car noses.
In the top row show the small original train side fin stowed flush on its shell near the rear/elbow section. In the open row, that SAME small fin is folded against the inside of the shell, with one restrained orange curved arrow showing its fold and one showing the shell hinge motion. It must not vanish or turn into a large wing.
Keep shell panel breaks, blue-window layout, orange stripe, fist size, wrist position and elbow position identical between rows; only hinges/open angle change. The wrist energy ring is a thin restrained cyan seam at its original wrist position, partly covered by the armored lip; no extra blue strips. This is the same four-finger-plus-thumb giant fist from reference 3, heavy and angular, not a small hand.
Style: the exact clean black ink / orange-ivory-graphite cel-shaded kinetic mecha art in the references. Precise readable volumes, restrained metal highlights, no photorealistic wash. No words, labels, logos, decorative frames or other objects. Entire elbow and entire fist visible, generous margins.
